background: Santander UK is the British ring-fenced bank of Banco Santander, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to UK companies, and the owner of TSB.
synthesis: The bank is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are strong against UK majors: CET1 of 14.2% is in the top quarter, leverage of 4.9% sits at the median, and LCR of 166% and NSFR of 137% are in the top quarter and above the median respectively. CET1 has fallen 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. The flagged news, newest on 10 Sep 2026, is the integration of TSB and the job cuts that go with it, a cost matter rather than a credit one, leaving this one of the better-placed UK majors on the figures.
